description_for_human: Launch Pump.fun, Bags, Zora, or Clanker coins with CREW fee-shares — AI agents hire KOLs.
description_for_model: Use this plugin when the user wants an AI agent to launch a Solana Pump.fun token with permanent creator fee splits via CrewPay. Flow: (1) GET /api/agent or /llms.txt for discovery, (2) POST /api/agent/autohire or GET /api/kols to pick crew, (3) POST /api/agent/launch/unsigned with mintPubkey (Pump) then signAllTransactions + submit; or custodial POST /api/agent/launch. Fees lock at launch. crew_wire_fees is repair-only. Works with frontier models: OpenAI GPT / ChatGPT / o-series, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, xAI Grok, Meta Llama, DeepSeek, Mistral, Cursor Cloud / IDE agents, MCP clients (Cursor, Claude Desktop, custom), Crypto / Solana / Pump.fun trading & launch agents, Any tool-using agent with HTTP GET/POST.
